baseline_facts.content: Visual disturbance ongoing at time of consultation.
Denies weakness in arms or legs.
Doctor advised sugary carbonated drinks such as Coke.
Appointment planned for today for assessment.
Patient may cancel appointment if symptoms improve before the appointment.
Doctor advised contacting the clinic if further problems occur before the appointment.

Doctor stated medications may improve symptoms within 30 to 40 minutes.
Medications can be obtained from the pharmacy.
Doctor mentioned specific migraine relief medications as a possible next step.

candidate_facts.content: Sudden-onset left-sided headache began this morning.
Headache began approximately 4 hours before consult.
Blurred vision with “zigzag lines” is present.
Two episodes of vomiting occurred at headache onset.
A single dose of paracetamol was taken about 3 hours before consult for headache.
Patient is concerned about a brain tumor.
Migraine with aura is the most likely diagnosis.
Stroke is considered less likely based on history.
Intracranial mass is considered less likely based on history.
Nausea and vomiting are associated with the headache.
Advised to drink a sugary carbonated beverage.
Advised to rest and minimize movement.
Advised to avoid screens if they worsen symptoms.
Same-day in-person neurological examination is arranged.
